value.rationale: This directly resolves all 16 instances of an explicitly numbered open hypothesis in a recent primary logic article and strengthens the source language from one pair of b/n operators to all eight simultaneously. The invariant isolates a general expressivity boundary between local crisp propositional behavior and genuinely global modal variation, with smallest possible one-vs-two world countermodel shape. The precise distinction is useful for selecting primitive modal connectives and proving nondefinability in FDE-based expressive completeness investigations, beyond a routine restatement of an existing equivalence.
